title: Enterprise Connectivity: corrected monthly transfer assessment qualifying scope
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following eligibility and object boundaries for corrected monthly transfer assessment.

## Scope clause 15
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, for this monthly-aggregate rate-error review, the selected original charge is the sole posted primary internet outbound transfer charge for its holding and UTC month, its recorded quantity and completed reconciliation both represent the total posted internet outbound transfer quantity for that month, and the full month has ended.

## Scope clause 16
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, its original source-event reference may identify one contributing export; that legacy locator does not restrict this aggregate charge to that export alone.

## Scope clause 18
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, keep the original charge identifier as the correction source; no new charge, meter allocation or meter reversal is created.

## Scope clause 19
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, chronological source allocation and source-specific reversals continue to govern every charge outside this narrowly defined aggregate-review route.

## Scope clause 20
For corrected monthly transfer assessment, all contributing exports and the original charge must have the current holding tier and its unchanged commercial attributes, in US East, with the holding active throughout that UTC month; therefore its full monthly allowance and current tier rate apply.
